instruction: Search for arXiv papers about transformer language models published in September 2023 and add at least 2 papers to the spreadsheet with their title, arXiv link, and publication date.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and adding at least 2 arXiv papers about transformer language models from September 2023. The evaluator retrieves all rows with title, link, and date from columns A, B, C, then validates each row: (1) all 3 fields must be non-empty, (2) link must contain 'arxiv.org', (3) date must indicate September 2023 (supports formats like '2023.9', '2023.09', '2023-09', 'September 2023', etc.), and (4) title must contain transformer/language model keywords (transformer, BERT, GPT, language model, LLM, etc.). Returns 1.0 if at least 2 valid papers exist, 0.0 otherwise. Note: Original file already has 1 September paper (QWEN from 2023.9.29), so agent needs to add at least 1 more valid paper.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all 5 requirements from instruction: (1) arXiv source validated via 'arxiv.org' pattern in link (line 47-49), (2) September 2023 date validated with comprehensive pattern matching supporting multiple formats (lines 53-69), (3) transformer/language model topic validated via extensive keyword list (lines 22-27, 72-79), (4) all 3 required fields (title, link, date) verified as non-empty (lines 33-40), (5) minimum count of 2 papers enforced (line 84)
Getter correctly extracts rows from columns A, B, C starting from row 2 (header skip), returns list of tuples matching metric function's expected input format
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts (title, link, date) tuples → metric validates each tuple against all requirements → returns 1.0 if min_count valid papers exist
Postconfig properly handles file state: activates LibreOffice window, saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes, includes appropriate sleep times for UI operations
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('min_count') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules')
Date validation is robust: supports multiple formats including '2023.9', '2023.09', '2023-09', '2023/09', 'September 2023', 'Sept 2023' via regex patterns with case-insensitive matching
Topic validation uses comprehensive keyword list covering major transformer models (transformer, BERT, GPT, LLaMA, QWEN, T5, etc.) and related terms (attention, pretrained, language model, LLM, etc.)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding arxiv.org/abs/ pattern validation to ensure links are valid arXiv paper URLs, not just any arxiv.org page (current check accepts any URL containing 'arxiv.org')

Minor: The keyword matching is case-insensitive substring matching which could theoretically match unrelated papers (e.g., 'Transformers in Electrical Engineering'), though this is unlikely in practice given the arXiv context
